about_the_game:
Let's Dye Together is a fast-paced party platformer shooter where color is your greatest weapon!

Compete in a series of minigames, blasting platforms to claim them and creating paths only you can traverse. Adapt, shoot and survive in order to conquer the ever-changing battlefield.

Paint the Battlefield in Your Favor

Claim territory by blasting the environment with your color, creating safe paths that only you can traverse while making opponents movement more challenging. Stay alert as your surroundings might change against your favor at any time. 

Weapons

Wield a diverse arsenal of weapons, each with unique effects that shape the battlefield.

Game modes

Put your skills to the test across a variety of game modes including Last Man Standing, Domination, Capture the flag and more, each offering a unique twist on the color-based chaos. Whether you're fighting for dominance or racing against the clock, every match is a new challenge.

Adapt, Shoot, Survive

There’s no time to stand still. React fast and take control of the battlefield before your opponents do. Whether you're working together or fighting for dominance, Let's Dye Together delivers a high-energy, unpredictable experience where no two matches are ever the same.

One color to rule them all

Play with 2-4 players locally, pick a controller and your favorite color and let the fun begin!
